title: Purchase.Order.Pdf: print a purchase order as PDF

labels.name: intake:ready
labels.description: Story + acceptance criteria complete and verified; can be handed to the Coder

body:
<!-- moved-from-core-1046-to-orchestrator-20261018 -->
Gunnar assigned the PDF and Send proposals to **Bifröst Orchestrator** on18October2026. Linked replacement of https://github.com/OrigoSoftwareSolutions/bc-origo-bifrost-core/issues/1046; GitHub cannot natively transfer an issue between these different organization owners. The original remains available with its history.

**Parked backlog: no development, assignment or automatic recovery until authoritative removal of `intake:parked`. This move does not unpark the issue.**

Reuse Orchestrator report execution/layout/export infrastructure where compatible, while retaining the document-aware BC Report Selections usage, exact document/SystemId filters, normal read permissions, binary PDF and filename behavior. Report #5 covers generic layout/request-page parameters; #85 tracks invalid-filter/empty-PDF behavior. Those do not already satisfy this document-specific suggestion. Avoid an independent rendering engine or a duplicate generic SaveAs API.

This new direct routing decision supersedes the older placement note in #5 for these four proposed features only. Existing published Foundation PDF/Send implementations and wire names are not moved, renamed or removed by this backlog action. Keep the single Foundation dependency; do not add Inventory or language-model dependencies. Preserve the original proposed names and ACs for story refinement.

## Original suggestion (preserved)

## Problem

Callers can get PDFs of posted sales documents but not of a purchase order.

## Proposed message type(s)

`Purchase.Order.Pdf`

Mirrors: Report Selections usage P.Order (default report 1322 `Standard Purchase - Order`, verify), same pattern as Sales.SalesInvoice.Pdf.

## Draft acceptance criteria

- AC01: Takes a purchase order no. or SystemId and answers a base64 PDF and file name, using the report selection for P.Order.
- AC02: Refuses an unknown order (`RecordNotFound`).
- AC03: Uses the same read-permission check as Sales.SalesInvoice.Pdf.
- AC04: Every refusal answers a Bifröst error code with a `nextStep`; help in en-US and is-IS with XLF entries; tests for happy path, invalid input and an edge case.
- AC05: The message type name has exactly three dot-separated parts (Gunnar 16.10 naming rule).

Parked by Gunnar 16.10 (backlog). Not ready for development.
